business_definition: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to an enrolled member/patient.
Member legal first name.
Member legal last name.
Member birth date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Administrative gender of the member (M, F, Other).
Primary residential street address.
Secondary residential address line (apartment, suite, unit).
Residential city name.
Two-letter US postal state abbreviation code.
Five-digit or ZIP+4 postal code.
Primary contact telephone number.
Member electronic mail address.
Identifier of the active health insurance plan in which the member is enrolled.
Effective policy start date for insurance coverage.
Date coverage ended (NULL if policy is currently active).
Identifier of designated Primary Care Provider (PCP).
Unique identifier for healthcare provider or medical facility.
Official legal name of the practicing physician or healthcare facility.
Standard 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI).
Primary medical specialty or facility classification.
Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax ID.
Physical practice facility street address.
Practice suite, floor, or building identifier.
Practice location city.
Two-letter US postal state abbreviation code.
Practice location postal ZIP code.
Practice primary contact telephone number.
Current contractual status with the payer (Active, Terminated, Pending).
Network tier participation status (In-Network, Out-of-Network, Preferred).
Unique identifier for the health benefit insurance plan product.
Commercial marketing title of the insurance plan.
Health plan benefit design type (PPO, HMO, EPO, HDHP).
Geographical territory where the plan is licensed and active.
Annual deductible amount in USD required before cost-sharing applies.
Maximum annual out-of-pocket financial liability limit in USD.
Fixed copayment amount in USD for in-network primary care visits.
Fixed copayment amount in USD for specialist physician visits.
Percentage of covered expenses paid by the member after deductible is met.
Effective initiation date of plan offering.
Termination date of plan offering (NULL if currently active).
Standardized CPT or HCPCS medical procedure code.
Official clinical description of the medical procedure or service.
Clinical procedure category (Surgery, Eval & Management, Radiology, etc.).
Standard billing modifier code altering service delivery circumstances.
Standard allowable fee-schedule reimbursement rate in USD.
Identifier of associated coverage policy document in knowledge corpus.
Flag indicating whether procedure code is currently active and billable (TRUE/FALSE).
Unique transaction identifier for the medical claim header record.
Identifier of enrolled patient receiving healthcare services.
Identifier of healthcare provider or facility submitting the claim.
Identifier of insurance plan against which the claim is adjudicated.
Calendar date when claim transaction was received and logged by payer.
First calendar date of medical service delivery.
Final calendar date of medical service delivery.
Current adjudication processing status (Paid, Denied, Pending, Submitted).
Total dollar charge amount submitted by provider across all service lines.
Total fee-schedule allowable amount approved by payer for reimbursement.
Total dollar disbursement actually paid by payer.
Primary ICD-10 clinical diagnosis code justifying medical necessity.
Secondary or supporting ICD-10 clinical diagnosis code.
Unique identifier for individual service line item within a claim.
Identifier of parent claim header transaction.
Sequential index position of the service line within the parent claim.
CPT or HCPCS code representing the specific medical service rendered.
Specific date of service for this line item.
Dollar charge amount billed by provider for this specific line item.
Allowable fee-schedule dollar amount approved for this line item.
Final reimbursement dollar amount paid for this line item.
Number of procedure units or services performed.
CPT or HCPCS modifier altering clinical circumstances.
Standard Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) explaining line denial.
